predictions: Split names whose second piece carries a g reach 0.4-0.85; split names without a g piece (Bart|ó|k, B|é|la, Kal|id|asa, M|omp|esson) and whole-token g-names (Logan, Hogan, Ragnar, Vogue) stay under 0.05.
short: g-bearing piece inside a split name
notes: Probe: Zagreb/Vogel 0.854 (peak 'og'), Gábor 0.846 ('á'), Noguchi 0.724, intaglio 0.717 ('ag'), anterograde 0.608, Gogol 0.430; retrograde (retro|grade) 0.006, Bartók 0.002, Mortlake 0.018. Card: 'og' x12, 'á' x4, 'ag' x4, ' Vog' x4, ' Zag' x3. The - pole peaks on ' g'/'g'/'-g'/' г' as its own token, so the neuron separates a g that opens a piece (-) from a g carried inside a continuation piece (+). All test words tokenizer-checked.
